short.title: TypeSafe AI Launches 'Jev' Model for Probabilistic Software Integration
short.description:
By focusing on schema adherence rather than natural language generation, Jev aims to reduce structural errors in automated decision-making pipelines, though it remains susceptible to factual inaccuracies in its output values.
